newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds sees Q3 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds sees Q3 earnings below estimates.

text.p: The Reynolds and Reynods Co said Monday it expects to report lower-than-expected earning in the third quarter ending June 30 of $0.21 to $0.25 per share.
The company added that this estimate does not include pretax charges of between $20 million and $40 million in the third and fourth quarters for restructuring and related charges.
The Fist Call consensus earnings estimate of five analysts for the third quarter called for earnings of $0.33 per share.

The company said earnings are being impacted mainly by lower revenues in each of its principal businesses. Computer system sales are below expectations, said Reynolds. Sales are suffering because of the tentativeness of auto dealers in making buying decisions, various automobile manufacturer initiatives, slowing car sales and other related factors.

The company added that sales trends will be below second quarter levels in both business systems and automotive forms and sales in business systems are suffering from issues associated with intyegrating recent acquisitions.
Revenues for the third quarter are expected to be between $325 million and $340 million, the company said, which is higher than year-earlier results, but a drop from the preceding quarter.
The company expects to report third quarter earnings on Juky 21.
